title: ロボット制御
subtitle: Robot Control
educationalGoal:
(1) Learn kinematics and dynamics of robot manipulators.
(2) Learn modeling and control methods for robotic systems.
(3) Learn Q-learning and Python code for grid world environments.
advice:
This is a basic course in control engineering. We will mainly cover the following topics:
1. Fundamentals of Robot Control
2. Fundamentals of Reinforcement Learning

Students are expected to actively participate in class.
Students are expected to complete exercises independently.
Students are required to be aware of the instructor’s messages in the class and to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class because the course schedule may change depending on the class progress.
books: We have one textbook. The textbook is written in Japanese.
requiredKnowledge:
Sufficient mathematical skills (differential equations, integrals, and linear algebra).
Basic knowledge of dynamics and control engineering.

activityGoals.body: Represent position and orientation of manipulators mathematically.
Understand kinematics and calculate end point position.
Obtain a dynamic equation and understand position control.
Explain the role of the Bellman equation in dynamic programming.

achievementLevels.ideal: Be able to derive mathematical expressions for modeling a robot manipulator. Be able to implement position control for a robot using Python code and modify the control methods. Be able to appropriately set state value functions and action value functions for a grid world environment using Python code.
achievementLevels.standard: Be able to understand the mathematical model of a robot manipulator expressed in equations. Be able to implement position control for a robot using Python code. Be able to implement Q-learning in a grid world environment using Python code.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This is a basic course in control engineering. We will mainly cover the following topics:
1. Fundamentals of Robot Control
2. Fundamentals of Reinforcement Learning

Students are expected to actively participate in class.
Students are expected to complete exercises independently.
Students are required to be aware of the instructor’s messages in the class and to check for messages/materials on the KIT Inside website before every class because the course schedule may change depending on the class progress.
